items.name: 中文口播（母语听感，盲审）
中文屏幕文字（PPT 式画面）

evidence: Loss: a score for mistakes / Training: push it down
issues.fix: **Loss: a score for mistakes** / **Training: lower loss**
issues.orig: Loss: a score for mistakes / Training: push it down
issues.problem: The strict outro pairs a definition with an imperative. “It” also makes the summary depend on resolving a pronoun.
issues.suggest: **Loss: a score for mistakes** / **Training: lower loss**
issues.judge_note: outro / card_s6（b，必改「Training: lower loss」）：「lower」在这里既能读成形容词也能读成动词，「Training: lower loss」反而有歧义。现行两行都是「名词: 说明」结构，「it」紧接上一行的 Loss，指代清楚，不构成严格项问题。
issues.solution: 按裁决维持「名词: 说明」两行；第二行改 Training: push loss down（采纳 a 的 I2 可选写法），主语更明确

evidence: "Training: push it down"
issues.fix: Optional: "Training: push loss down"
issues.orig: "Training: push it down"
issues.problem: "it" resolves to "loss" in the line above, so it is fine on this card; "push loss down" would be unambiguous if the line is ever reused alone. Outro stays within limits (9 words plus "Next · Gradient descent").
issues.suggest: Optional: "Training: push loss down"
issues.solution: 同 I1

evidence: h1 "Model = a machine with knobs"
issues.fix: "Model = machine + knobs" (4 words)
issues.orig: h1 "Model = a machine with knobs"
issues.problem: Cold open is a strict item. The h1 is the narration clause repeated word for word ("a model is a machine with knobs"). The "Last time" eyebrow makes it a recap, which softens it, but it is still the narration on screen. If the strict rule is applied literally, treat as 必改.
issues.suggest: "Model = machine + knobs" (4 words)
issues.solution: l01 标题改 Model = machine + knobs（4 词，不再照抄口播）

evidence: eyebrow "The rule for scoring mistakes" (5 words)
issues.fix: No change
issues.orig: eyebrow "The rule for scoring mistakes" (5 words)
issues.problem: Exempt as an eyebrow, but it is really the definition and is long for the role. Reads well and is correct next to "Loss function"; keep.
issues.suggest: No change
issues.reason: 记录级：a 自己写明不改

evidence: Lower is better
issues.fix: **Lower loss = better**
issues.orig: Lower is better
issues.problem: This is a complete sentence taken verbatim from l07’s narration. The relationship can remain without sentence syntax.
issues.suggest: **Lower loss = better**
issues.judge_note: l07–l08（b，「Lower is better」必改）：问题本身成立（与口播一字不差），但这是业内通用的 3 词标签，算不上整句口播，级别降为建议。b 的改写「Lower loss = better」可以用。
issues.solution: 改 Lower loss = better（裁决人认可的写法）

evidence: Golf: fewest strokes wins
issues.fix: **Golf: fewer strokes**
issues.orig: Golf: fewest strokes wins
issues.problem: “Strokes wins” sounds grammatically off. It also turns a simple analogy label into another explanatory clause.
issues.suggest: **Golf: fewer strokes**
issues.judge_note: l08（b，语法）：「fewest strokes wins」是英语惯用的省略说法（同「most votes wins」），不是主谓不一致。这一屏只有补充问题里的版式问题要改，文字不用改。
issues.reason: 裁决人：fewest strokes wins 是英语惯用省略（同 most votes wins）

evidence: 卡片「Golf: fewest strokes wins」
issues.fix: 卡片再加宽约 40px，或把这一行字号降到 48px；文字不改
issues.orig: 卡片「Golf: fewest strokes wins」
issues.problem: 文字右端顶到卡片边框（s2_l08，「wins」与卡片右缘齐平），左边有约 40px 内边距、右边是 0，看起来像被裁掉。round-1 I11 加宽卡片后仍未留出右边距。
issues.suggest: 卡片再加宽约 40px，或把这一行字号降到 48px；文字不改
issues.solution: 高尔夫卡英文再加宽 40px（740 → 780），右侧留出内边距

evidence: "✗ Higher: turn back"
issues.fix: "✗ Loss up: turn back" (or add "✓ Loss down: keep" in green, 4 words each, as one two-row list)
issues.orig: "✗ Higher: turn back"
issues.problem: Only the failing half of the rule appears, "Higher" has no subject (higher what?), and narration gives both branches ("keep it / turn it back").
issues.suggest: "✗ Loss up: turn back" (or add "✓ Loss down: keep" in green, 4 words each, as one two-row list)
issues.judge_note: l09（a，「Only the failing half of the rule appears」）：前提不成立。scenes/web/s2.html 里有「✓ Lower: keep it」(#ok) 和「✗ Higher: turn back」(#bad) 两句先后出现，截图只截到后一句的那一刻。「Higher」承接前一句的「Lower」，主语也是清楚的。
issues.reason: 裁决人：✓ / ✗ 两句先后出现，截图只截到后一句

evidence: 「Actual $23」
issues.fix: 「Actual $23」右移约 40px 或上移 30px，避开数据点
issues.orig: 「Actual $23」
issues.problem: 标签压在约 6 km 处的灰色数据点上（s3_l15，「Actual」中部遮住一个点），红色方块里也盖着两个灰点。
issues.suggest: 「Actual $23」右移约 40px 或上移 30px，避开数据点
issues.solution: 「Actual $23 / 实际 23」移到数据点正上方，避开 6 公里处的点

evidence: They cancel out
issues.fix: **Error cancellation**
issues.orig: They cancel out
issues.problem: A complete sentence repeats the narrated explanation; the pronoun contributes no useful structure.
issues.suggest: **Error cancellation**
issues.judge_note: l18–l19（b，「Error cancellation」）：抽象名词比「They cancel out」更难懂，也没有对应画面上一正一负的两个标注。原文 3 词，维持。
issues.reason: 裁决人：抽象名词更难懂，原文 3 词维持

evidence: h2 "Off by 2 → 4" / h2 "Off by 8 → 64"
issues.fix: No change
issues.orig: h2 "Off by 2 → 4" / h2 "Off by 8 → 64"
issues.problem: Counts as 4 blocks only if the two lines are a look-alike list (they are, 4 words each); keep them in one visual group. Not a breach as laid out; the screen is at the 4-block limit with 15 words.
issues.suggest: No change
issues.reason: 记录级：a 自己写明不改

evidence: Chart block: "Per km →", "Starting fare →", "2 · 13.4", "3 · 2.19", "1 · 78", ("Lowest point")
issues.fix: l29-l30: drop the green "Lowest point" label (h1 "Find the lowest point" and the card "Lowest loss" already say it) so the block is 10 or 9; l28: no change needed under the numbering reading
issues.orig: Chart block: "Per km →", "Starting fare →", "2 · 13.4", "3 · 2.19", "1 · 78", ("Lowest point")
issues.problem: Under the round-2 ruling the whole chart is one block and in-chart text counts. By the tool's count that is 10 words (l28) and 12 words (l29, l30), over the 9-word limit. If the leading try numbers count as "numbering" it is 7 and 9, which passes. Needs the ruling on whether "2 ·" is numbering.
issues.suggest: l29-l30: drop the green "Lowest point" label (h1 "Find the lowest point" and the card "Lowest loss" already say it) so the block is 10 or 9; l28: no change needed under the numbering reading
issues.solution: 绿环标签改 Lowest · 1.97（裁决人写法），放在环的右上、离开 3 · 2.19

evidence: Lowest point / 3 · 2.19 / Lowest loss 1.97
issues.fix: Replace the chart callout with **Minimum: 1.97**; remove the earlier trial callouts on these two screens and attach the minimum label unambiguously
issues.orig: Lowest point / 3 · 2.19 / Lowest loss 1.97
issues.problem: The green minimum ring encloses the apparent trial-3 marker. The nearby labels imply that the same marked point has two scores. The previous fix has not removed that ambiguity.
issues.suggest: Replace the chart callout with **Minimum: 1.97**; remove the earlier trial callouts on these two screens and attach the minimum label unambiguously
issues.judge_note: l29–l30（b，「remove the earlier trial callouts」）：删掉三次尝试的标签，会断掉 l28 →「the third nearly at the bottom」的视觉连续。应保留尝试标签，把绿环的「Lowest point」改成「Lowest · 1.97」，挂在环的另一侧、离开「3 · 2.19」。图内仍是 9 词，同一个点两个分数的问题也就解决了。
issues.solution: 同 I12（保留三次尝试的标签）

evidence: It only sees the score
issues.fix: **Only the score**
issues.orig: It only sees the score
issues.problem: This strict chapter title remains a complete explanatory sentence. Its five-word length does not make it an outline label.
issues.suggest: **Only the score**
issues.judge_note: c_lens（b，必改「Only the score」）：现行章名「It only sees the score」是第 1 轮裁决人给的写法，5 词，读出来自然。章名用一句短句是常见做法，不属于整句口播。「Only the score」去掉了「谁只看分数」，更费解。维持原文。
issues.solution: 章名英文改 The model only sees the score（采纳 voice_en 裁决 I40：It 指代不清）

evidence: h1 "Lowest score ≠ 0" beside card "Lowest loss 1.97"
issues.fix: h1 "Lowest loss ≠ 0" (or change the card label to "Lowest score")
issues.orig: h1 "Lowest score ≠ 0" beside card "Lowest loss 1.97"
issues.problem: Two names for one quantity on the same screen. The card also stays through l32, so the viewer sees both together.
issues.suggest: h1 "Lowest loss ≠ 0" (or change the card label to "Lowest score")
issues.solution: 标题改 Lowest loss ≠ 0，与读数「Lowest loss」同名；中文同步「最低损失 ≠ 0」

evidence: Sees only the score / No idea what a taxi is
issues.fix: **Score only**; delete the secondary line
issues.orig: Sees only the score / No idea what a taxi is
issues.problem: Both lines reproduce the two narrated claims. Removing their subjects has not created a useful division of work.
issues.suggest: **Score only**; delete the secondary line
issues.judge_note: l34（b，「Score only」并删除第二行）：第 1 轮 I24 已以「太省，丢了对比」驳回，这次重提又没有新理由。改法见补充问题 l34。
issues.solution: 按裁决人补充 l34：h1 改 Taxi? No idea，删掉 h2；中文同步「打车？不认识」

evidence: 页眉「03 · It only sees the score」+ h1「Sees only the score」
issues.fix: h1 改「Taxi? No idea」（3 词），删掉 h2。页眉负责章节结论，1.97 卡负责分数，h1 负责「不认识出租车」这层对比，三层各有分工
issues.orig: 页眉「03 · It only sees the score」+ h1「Sees only the score」
issues.problem: 同屏两层文字几乎同句，只是换了语序，第二层没有新信息；h2「No idea what a taxi is」又照搬口播。两位审稿人都没指出两层重复。
issues.suggest: h1 改「Taxi? No idea」（3 词），删掉 h2。页眉负责章节结论，1.97 卡负责分数，h1 负责「不认识出租车」这层对比，三层各有分工
issues.solution: 同 I16

evidence: How you score shapes learning / Squaring punishes big misses
issues.fix: **Scoring → learning** / **Squared penalties**
issues.orig: How you score shapes learning / Squaring punishes big misses
issues.problem: Both are complete explanatory sentences. Together they reproduce the narration instead of labelling the visual comparison.
issues.suggest: **Scoring → learning** / **Squared penalties**
issues.judge_note: l35–l36（b，「Scoring → learning / Squared penalties」）：「Squared penalties」在第 1 轮 I26 已被驳回，它只是标签，丢了「大错罚得狠」这个结论，而 l36 的方块图正是在证明这个结论。维持「Squaring punishes big misses」，只修折行。
issues.reason: 裁决人：Squared penalties 丢了结论；按 I19 只修折行（改成一行的 Big misses cost most）

evidence: h2「Squaring punishes big / misses」
issues.fix: 文字列加宽或设 `text-wrap: balance` 让两行均衡；也可改成「Big misses cost most」（4 词，一行放得下）
issues.orig: h2「Squaring punishes big / misses」
issues.problem: 折行后第二行只剩「misses」一个词（s4_l36），和 l45 孤词是同一类问题。
issues.suggest: 文字列加宽或设 `text-wrap: balance` 让两行均衡；也可改成「Big misses cost most」（4 词，一行放得下）
issues.solution: 改 Big misses cost most（裁决人给的一行写法），不再折行

issues.fix: Optional: "4 × off by 2 = 16" / "1 × off by 8 = 64" (kept as one chart block, 10 words)
issues.problem: Arithmetic with no referent: the viewer has to remember that 4 means "four small misses" and 8 means "one big miss". Works because l35 and the earlier squares set it up, but it is the least self-explaining screen.
issues.suggest: Optional: "4 × off by 2 = 16" / "1 × off by 8 = 64" (kept as one chart block, 10 words)
issues.judge_note: l36（a 的可选改写「4 × off by 2 = 16 / 1 × off by 8 = 64」）：a 自己写明 10 词，超过单块 9 词的上限，可读性也不比现行算式好。驳回。
issues.reason: 裁决人：10 词超上限，可读性不比算式好

evidence: Loss defines “good”
issues.fix: **Defining “good”**
issues.orig: Loss defines “good”
issues.problem: Another complete sentence at a chapter close. More importantly, narration attributes this choice to the **loss function**, whereas the slide names the **loss**.
issues.suggest: **Defining “good”**
issues.judge_note: l37（b 的改写「Defining “good”」）：问题成立（loss 与 loss function 混用），但改写把主语删了，看不出是谁在定义「好」。应改为「Loss function defines “good”」（4 词）。
issues.solution: 改 Loss function defines “good”（裁决人写法，不再把 loss 与 loss function 混用）

evidence: h2 "Scored in training, too"
issues.fix: "Scored too, but not on fares" (5 words), or "Same idea, new target" (4)
issues.orig: h2 "Scored in training, too"
issues.problem: Strict chapter opener. It echoes the narration and omits the new point, "not for taxi fares".
issues.suggest: "Scored too, but not on fares" (5 words), or "Same idea, new target" (4)
issues.solution: 副标题改 Scored too, but not on fares（a 的写法，带上「不是车费了」的对比）

evidence: Training loss keeps falling / Still falling ↓
issues.fix: **Training loss ↓**; delete **Still falling ↓**
issues.orig: Training loss keeps falling / Still falling ↓
issues.problem: The secondary heading is a full sentence. At l45, the chart callout states the same trend again while narration also explains it.
issues.suggest: **Training loss ↓**; delete **Still falling ↓**
issues.judge_note: l43–l45（b，删除「Still falling ↓」）：曲线末端的这个标注正好出现在口播说「still falling」的那一刻，标的是曲线上的位置，有自己的作用。只需把 h2 缩短成一行，按 a 的改法用「Loss keeps falling」。
issues.solution: h2 改 Loss keeps falling（一行）；曲线末端 Still falling ↓ 按裁决保留

evidence: h2 "Training loss keeps falling" (wraps, "falling" alone on line 2)
issues.fix: "Loss keeps falling" (3 words, one line)
issues.orig: h2 "Training loss keeps falling" (wraps, "falling" alone on line 2)
issues.problem: Orphan word, also duplicates the curve label "Still falling ↓" at l45.
issues.suggest: "Loss keeps falling" (3 words, one line)
issues.solution: 同 I23

evidence: Tens of billions of knobs
issues.fix: **Billions of knobs**; keep the text clear of the illustration
issues.orig: Tens of billions of knobs
issues.problem: The final words overlap the miniature knobs. This is visible obstruction, not a shortage of reading time.
issues.suggest: **Billions of knobs**; keep the text clear of the illustration
issues.judge_note: l46（b 的改写「Billions of knobs」）：遮挡问题成立，但把数量改成「billions」，和口播「tens of billions」不一致。应保留文字，把旋钮阵列右移，或给左列文字留够宽度（例如阵列起点移到 x≥840）。
issues.solution: 英文左列宽 560 → 720px，文字不再压旋钮阵列；数量按口播保留 tens of billions

evidence: 损失函数是什么／做个小实验／模型只认分数／大模型怎么打分
issues.fix: 若要统一：损失函数是什么／做个小实验／模型看什么／大模型怎么打分（不建议动，现版已通顺）

issues.suggest: 若要统一：损失函数是什么／做个小实验／模型看什么／大模型怎么打分（不建议动，现版已通顺）

evidence: 给错误打分的规则（22px 小标签）／ 损失函数（132px）／ Loss function（54px）
issues.fix: 标签字号提到约 34px（仍在标题之下）；或改为 h2「给错误打分的规则」放在 Loss function 之上，英文降为小注
issues.orig: 给错误打分的规则（22px 小标签）／ 损失函数（132px）／ Loss function（54px）
issues.problem: 开场要交代的定义（损失函数＝给错误打分的规则）放在最小的一级，视线先落到橙色大字和英文，定义读不到；开场属从严项，但这里只是层级偏弱，读起来不怪，故不升必改
issues.suggest: 标签字号提到约 34px（仍在标题之下）；或改为 h2「给错误打分的规则」放在 Loss function 之上，英文降为小注
issues.reason: 建议级：眉标是小标签，定义由 l04 口播说出；同屏大字留给术语本身，层级是有意的

evidence: 就像／高尔夫：杆数越少越好
issues.fix: 删除“就像”；改为“高尔夫：杆数 ↓”
issues.orig: 就像／高尔夫：杆数越少越好
issues.problem: 与对应口播几乎逐字重叠，也重复上一屏已经讲清的“越低越好”。拒绝“杆少者胜”的理由成立，仍可改成简短标签。
issues.suggest: 删除“就像”；改为“高尔夫：杆数 ↓”
issues.judge_note: b · l08（改成「高尔夫：杆数 ↓」，删掉「就像」）：这一屏的「分越低越好」和「高尔夫：杆数越少越好」是有意的并列，类比就靠这两句同构来成立。改成「杆数 ↓」会拆掉并列，还多一个符号化写法（a 在 P4 已把 l46「分 ↓」记为偏符号化）。现版 9 字，没有超限，保留。
issues.reason: 裁决人：「分越低越好」与「高尔夫：杆数越少越好」有意并列，保留

evidence: ✗ 分高了：拧回来
issues.fix: 分高了：拧回来（颜色已是红，符号可省）
issues.orig: ✗ 分高了：拧回来
issues.problem: 符号 ✗ 与文字混排；全片体例一致（l19 的 ✗ 已删），读得懂
issues.suggest: 分高了：拧回来（颜色已是红，符号可省）
issues.judge_note: a · l09（删掉「✗」，只留「分高了：拧回来」）：s2.html 里「✓ 分低了：拧对了」和「✗ 分高了：拧回来」是成对出现的。✓／✗ 和红绿配色一起区分两种结果，对红绿色弱的观众是必要的冗余，不应该删。
issues.reason: 裁决人：✓ / ✗ 是给红绿色弱观众的冗余，保留

evidence: 三种拧法对比；第一种 78／第二种 13.4／第三种 2.19
issues.fix: 标题保留；三行改为“① 78”“② 13.4”“③ 2.19”，保留第三行绿色强调

issues.problem: 隔两屏同一组拧法换了两种编号写法，口播一直说「第一种……」。不影响理解，但 b 对 l25 的改写（改成 ①②③）正好能把两屏统一起来
